title: [Core] idle nodes fail to scale down due to idle_time_ms resetting
description:
What happened + What you expected to happen
Idle worker nodes (0 GPU/CPU usage, no scheduled tasks) never scale down while other nodes in the cluster are still running tasks.
Also, activity shows up as "Busy workers on node" and "Resource: GPU currently in use" even when node is idle and idle counter is accumulating.

Expected: each node's idle timer accumulates independently and triggers scale-down after idle_timeout_minutes regardless of peer node activity

Actual: idle_duration_ms resets simultaneously on ALL nodes whenever a worker lease is released on ANY node, so the idle timer never accumulates past the inter-task interval

Hypothesis: the WorkFootprint/leased-worker tracking introduced to fix "blocked task" misclassification appears to reset idle_duration_ms cluster-wide as a side effect of worker lease lifecycle events. The autoscaler.py scale-down decision is correctly per-node, but the idle_duration_ms signal from GetClusterResourceState is being corrupted by unrelated nodes' lease events

Versions / Dependencies
Ray version: 2.54.0
OS: Linux (GCP)
Python version: Python 3.10.12
GPU: 4x nodes × 2x V100
Autoscaler: v2
